paragraphs.text: but Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
paragraphs.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Iēsous de eporeuthē eis to oros tōn Elaiōn.

paragraphs.text: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
paragraphs.original: Ὄρθρου δὲ πάλιν παρεγένετο εἰς τὸ ἱερόν, καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ἤρχετο· καὶ καθίσας ἐδίδασκεν αὐτούς.
paragraphs.translit: Orthrou de palin paregeneto eis to hieron, kai pas ho laos ērcheto· kai kathisas edidasken autous.

paragraphs.text: And the scribes and the Pharisees bring a woman taken in adultery; and having set her in the midst,
paragraphs.original: ἄγουσιν δὲ οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι πρὸς αὐτὸν γυναῖκα ἐν μοιχείᾳ καταλήφθεισαν· καὶ στήσαντες αὐτὴν ἐν μέσῳ,
paragraphs.translit: agousin de hoi grammateis kai hoi Pharisaioi pros auton gynaika en moicheia katalēphtheisan· kai stēsantes autēn en mesō,

paragraphs.text: they say unto him, Teacher, this woman hath been taken in adultery, in the very act.
paragraphs.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ, πειράζοντες· Διδάσκαλε, αὕτη ἡ γυνὴ κατελήφθη ἐπʼ αὐτοφόρῳ μοιχευομένη.
paragraphs.translit: legousin autō, peirazontes· Didaskale, hautē hē gynē katelēphthē epʼ autophorō moicheuomenē.

paragraphs.text: Now in the law Moses commanded us to stone such: what then sayest thou of her?
paragraphs.original: ἐν δὲ τῷ νόμῳ Μωσῆς ἡμῖν ἐνετείλατο τὰς τοιαύτας λιθοβολεῖσθαι· σὺ οὖν τί λέγεις;
paragraphs.translit: en de tō nomō Mōsēs hēmin eneteilato tas toiautas lithoboleisthai· sy oun ti legeis;

paragraphs.text: And this they said, trying him, that they might have [whereof] to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγον πειράζοντες αὐτόν, ἵνα ἔχωσιν κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ. ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς κάτω κύψας, τῷ δακτύλῳ ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν, μὴ προσποιούμενος.
paragraphs.translit: touto de elegon peirazontes auton, hina echōsin katēgorein autou. ho de Iēsous katō kypsas, tō daktylō egraphen eis tēn gēn, mē prospoioumenos.

paragraphs.text: But when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
paragraphs.original: ὡς δὲ ἐπέμενον ἐρωτῶντες αὐτόν, ἀνακύψας εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς· Ὁ ἀναμάρτητος ὑμῶν, πρῶτον ἐπʼ αὐτὴν τὸν λίθον βαλέτω.
paragraphs.translit: hōs de epemenon erōtōntes auton, anakypsas eipen pros autous· Ho anamartētos hymōn, prōton epʼ autēn ton lithon baletō.

paragraphs.text: And again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάλιν κάτω κύψας ἔγραφεν εἰς τὴν γῆν.
paragraphs.translit: kai palin katō kypsas egraphen eis tēn gēn.

paragraphs.text: And they, when they heard it, went out one by one, beginning from the eldest, [even] unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman, where she was, in the midst.
paragraphs.original: οἱ δέ, ἀκούσαντες, καὶ ὑπὸ τῆς συνειδήσεως ἐλεγχόμενοι, ἐξήρχοντο εἷς καθʼ εἷς, ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων· καὶ κατελείφθη μόνος ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἐν μέσῳ οὖσα.
paragraphs.translit: hoi de, akousantes, kai hypo tēs syneidēseōs elenchomenoi, exērchonto heis kathʼ heis, arxamenoi apo tōn presbyterōn· kai kateleiphthē monos ho Iēsous, kai hē gynē en mesō ousa.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus lifted up himself, and said unto her, Woman, where are they? did no man condemn thee?
paragraphs.original: ἀνακύψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ μηδένα θεασάμενος πλὴν τὴς γυναικός, εἶπεν αὐτῇ· Ποῦ εἰσιν ἐκεῖνοι οἱ κατήγοροί σου; Οὐδείς σε κατέκρινεν;
paragraphs.translit: anakypsas de ho Iēsous, kai mēdena theasamenos plēn tēs gynaikos, eipen autē· Pou eisin ekeinoi hoi katēgoroi sou; Oudeis se katekrinen;

paragraphs.text: And she said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said, Neither do I condemn thee: go thy way; from henceforth sin no more.
paragraphs.original: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν· Οὐδείς, κύριε. εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Οὐδὲ ἐγώ σε κρίνω· πορεύου καὶ μηκέτι ἁμάρτανε.⟧
paragraphs.translit: hē de eipen· Oudeis, kyrie. eipen de ho Iēsous· Oude egō se krinō· poreuou kai mēketi hamartane.⟧

paragraphs.text: Again therefore Jesus spake unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in the darkness, but shall have the light of life.
paragraphs.original: Πάλιν οὖν αὐτοῖς ἐλάλησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγων· Ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου· ὁ ἀκολουθῶν ἐμοὶ οὐ μὴ περιπατήσῃ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ, ἀλλʼ ἕξει τὸ φῶς τῆς ζωῆς.
paragraphs.translit: Palin oun autois elalēsen ho Iēsous legōn· Egō eimi to phōs tou kosmou· ho akolouthōn emoi ou mē peripatēsē en tē skotia, allʼ hexei to phōs tēs zōēs.

paragraphs.text: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest witness of thyself; thy witness is not true.
paragraphs.original: εἶπον οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι· Σὺ περὶ σεαυτοῦ μαρτυρεῖς· ἡ μαρτυρία σου οὐκ ἔστιν ἀληθής.
paragraphs.translit: eipon oun autō hoi Pharisaioi· Sy peri seautou martyreis· hē martyria sou ouk estin alēthēs.

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered and said unto them, Even if I bear witness of myself, my witness is true; for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye know not whence I come, or whither I go.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Κἂν ἐγὼ μαρτυρῶ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ, ἀληθής ἐστιν ἡ μαρτυρία μου, ὅτι οἶδα πόθεν ἦλθον καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγω· ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ οἴδατε πόθεν ἔρχομαι ἢ ποῦ ὑπάγω.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autois· Kan egō martyrō peri emautou, alēthēs estin hē martyria mou, hoti oida pothen ēlthon kai pou hypagō· hymeis de ouk oidate pothen erchomai ē pou hypagō.

paragraphs.text: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς κατὰ τὴν σάρκα κρίνετε, ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω οὐδένα.
paragraphs.translit: hymeis kata tēn sarka krinete, egō ou krinō oudena.

paragraphs.text: Yea and if I judge, my judgment is true; for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐὰν κρίνω δὲ ἐγώ, ἡ κρίσις ἡ ἐμὴ ἀληθινή ἐστιν, ὅτι μόνος οὐκ εἰμί, ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ πέμψας με πατήρ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ean krinō de egō, hē krisis hē emē alēthinē estin, hoti monos ouk eimi, allʼ egō kai ho pempsas me patēr.

paragraphs.text: Yea and in your law it is written, that the witness of two men is true.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ δὲ τῷ ὑμετέρῳ γέγραπται ὅτι δύο ἀνθρώπων ἡ μαρτυρία ἀληθής ἐστιν.
paragraphs.translit: kai en tō nomō de tō hymeterō gegraptai hoti dyo anthrōpōn hē martyria alēthēs estin.

paragraphs.text: I am he that beareth witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
paragraphs.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ καὶ μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ ὁ πέμψας με πατήρ.
paragraphs.translit: egō eimi ho martyrōn peri emautou kai martyrei peri emou ho pempsas me patēr.

paragraphs.text: They said therefore unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye know neither me, nor my Father: if ye knew me, ye would know my Father also.
paragraphs.original: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ· Ποῦ ἐστιν ὁ πατήρ σου; ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Οὔτε ἐμὲ οἴδατε οὔτε τὸν πατέρα μου· εἰ ἐμὲ ᾔδειτε, καὶ τὸν πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε.
paragraphs.translit: elegon oun autō· Pou estin ho patēr sou; apekrithē Iēsous· Oute eme oidate oute ton patera mou· ei eme ēdeite, kai ton patera mou an ēdeite.

paragraphs.text: These words spake he in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man took him; because his hour was not yet come.
paragraphs.original: ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐλάλησεν ἐν τῷ γαζοφυλακίῳ διδάσκων ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ· καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐπίασεν αὐτόν, ὅτι οὔπω ἐληλύθει ἡ ὥρα αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: tauta ta rhēmata elalēsen en tō gazophylakiō didaskōn en tō hierō· kai oudeis epiasen auton, hoti oupō elēlythei hē hōra autou.

paragraphs.text: He said therefore again unto them, I go away, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sin: whither I go, ye cannot come.
paragraphs.original: Εἶπεν οὖν πάλιν αὐτοῖς· Ἐγὼ ὑπάγω καὶ ζητήσετέ με, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ὑμῶν ἀποθανεῖσθε· ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: Eipen oun palin autois· Egō hypagō kai zētēsete me, kai en tē hamartia hymōn apothaneisthe· hopou egō hypagō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein.

paragraphs.text: The Jews therefore said, Will he kill himself, that he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come?
paragraphs.original: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Μήτι ἀποκτενεῖ ἑαυτὸν ὅτι λέγει· Ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω ὑμεῖς οὐ δύνασθε ἐλθεῖν;
paragraphs.translit: elegon oun hoi Ioudaioi· Mēti apoktenei heauton hoti legei· Hopou egō hypagō hymeis ou dynasthe elthein;

paragraphs.text: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς· Ὑμεῖς ἐκ τῶν κάτω ἐστέ, ἐγὼ ἐκ τῶν ἄνω εἰμί· ὑμεῖς ἐκ τούτου τοῦ κόσμου ἐστέ, ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου τούτου.
paragraphs.translit: kai elegen autois· Hymeis ek tōn katō este, egō ek tōn anō eimi· hymeis ek toutou tou kosmou este, egō ouk eimi ek tou kosmou toutou.

paragraphs.text: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for except ye believe that I am [he], ye shall die in your sins.
paragraphs.original: εἶπον οὖν ὑμῖν ὅτι ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν· ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ πιστεύσητε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐν ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: eipon oun hymin hoti apothaneisthe en tais hamartiais hymōn· ean gar mē pisteusēte hoti egō eimi, apothaneisthe en tais hamartiais hymōn.

paragraphs.text: They said therefore unto him, Who art thou? Jesus said unto them, Even that which I have also spoken unto you from the beginning.
paragraphs.original: ἔλεγον οὖν αὐτῷ· Σὺ τίς εἶ; εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Τὴν ἀρχὴν ὅ τι καὶ λαλῶ ὑμῖν;
paragraphs.translit: elegon oun autō· Sy tis ei; eipen autois ho Iēsous· Tēn archēn ho ti kai lalō hymin;

paragraphs.text: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you: howbeit he that sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these speak I unto the world.
paragraphs.original: πολλὰ ἔχω περὶ ὑμῶν λαλεῖν καὶ κρίνειν· ἀλλʼ ὁ πέμψας με ἀληθής ἐστιν, κἀγὼ ἃ ἤκουσα παρʼ αὐτοῦ ταῦτα λαλῶ εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
paragraphs.translit: polla echō peri hymōn lalein kai krinein· allʼ ho pempsas me alēthēs estin, kagō ha ēkousa parʼ autou tauta lalō eis ton kosmon.

paragraphs.text: They perceived not that he spake to them of the Father.
paragraphs.original: οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῖς ἔλεγεν.
paragraphs.translit: ouk egnōsan hoti ton patera autois elegen.

paragraphs.text: Jesus therefore said, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am [he], and [that] I do nothing of myself, but as the Father taught me, I speak these things.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὅταν ὑψώσητε τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, τότε γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι, καὶ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ ποιῶ οὐδέν, ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἐδίδαξέν με ὁ πατὴρ ταῦτα λαλῶ.
paragraphs.translit: eipen oun ho Iēsous· Hotan hypsōsēte ton hyion tou anthrōpou, tote gnōsesthe hoti egō eimi, kai apʼ emautou poiō ouden, alla kathōs edidaxen me ho patēr tauta lalō.

paragraphs.text: And he that sent me is with me; he hath not left me alone; for I do always the things that are pleasing to him.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὁ πέμψας με μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν· οὐκ ἀφῆκέν με μόνον, ὅτι ἐγὼ τὰ ἀρεστὰ αὐτῷ ποιῶ πάντοτε.
paragraphs.translit: kai ho pempsas me metʼ emou estin· ouk aphēken me monon, hoti egō ta aresta autō poiō pantote.

paragraphs.text: As he spake these things, many believed on him.
paragraphs.original: ταῦτα αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: tauta autou lalountos polloi episteusan eis auton.

paragraphs.text: Jesus therefore said to those Jews that had believed him, If ye abide in my word, [then] are ye truly my disciples;
paragraphs.original: Ἔλεγεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς πεπιστευκότας αὐτῷ Ἰουδαίους· Ἐὰν ὑμεῖς μείνητε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῷ ἐμῷ, ἀληθῶς μαθηταί μού ἐστε,
paragraphs.translit: Elegen oun ho Iēsous pros tous pepisteukotas autō Ioudaious· Ean hymeis meinēte en tō logō tō emō, alēthōs mathētai mou este,

paragraphs.text: and ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
paragraphs.original: καὶ γνώσεσθε τὴν ἀλήθειαν, καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια ἐλευθερώσει ὑμᾶς.
paragraphs.translit: kai gnōsesthe tēn alētheian, kai hē alētheia eleutherōsei hymas.

paragraphs.text: They answered unto him, We are Abraham`s seed, and have never yet been in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθησαν πρὸς αὐτόν· Σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐσμεν καὶ οὐδενὶ δεδουλεύκαμεν πώποτε· πῶς σὺ λέγεις ὅτι Ἐλεύθεροι γενήσεσθε;
paragraphs.translit: apekrithēsan pros auton· Sperma Abraam esmen kai oudeni dedouleukamen pōpote· pōs sy legeis hoti Eleutheroi genēsesthe;

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Every one that committeth sin is the bondservant of sin.
paragraphs.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν ἁμαρτίαν δοῦλός ἐστιν τῆς ἁμαρτίας·
paragraphs.translit: Apekrithē autois ho Iēsous· Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti pas ho poiōn tēn hamartian doulos estin tēs hamartias·

paragraphs.text: And the bondservant abideth not in the house for ever: the son abideth for ever.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ δοῦλος οὐ μένει ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα· ὁ υἱὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
paragraphs.translit: ho de doulos ou menei en tē oikia eis ton aiōna· ho hyios menei eis ton aiōna.

paragraphs.text: If therefore the Son shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
paragraphs.original: ἐὰν οὖν ὁ υἱὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλευθερώσῃ, ὄντως ἐλεύθεροι ἔσεσθε.
paragraphs.translit: ean oun ho hyios hymas eleutherōsē, ontōs eleutheroi esesthe.

paragraphs.text: I know that ye are Abraham`s seed: yet ye seek to kill me, because my word hath not free course in you.
paragraphs.original: οἶδα ὅτι σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ ἐστε· ἀλλὰ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ὅτι ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν.
paragraphs.translit: oida hoti sperma Abraam este· alla zēteite me apokteinai, hoti ho logos ho emos ou chōrei en hymin.

paragraphs.text: I speak the things which I have seen with [my] Father: and ye also do the things which ye heard from [your] father.
paragraphs.original: ἃ ἐγὼ ἑώρακα παρὰ τῷ πατρὶ λαλῶ· καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν ἃ ἠκούσατε παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ποιεῖτε.
paragraphs.translit: ha egō heōraka para tō patri lalō· kai hymeis oun ha ēkousate para tou patros poieite.

paragraphs.text: They answered and said unto him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham`s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
paragraphs.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ ἐστιν. λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ τέκνα τοῦ Ἀβραάμ ἐστε, τὰ ἔργα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ ἐποιεῖτε·
paragraphs.translit: Apekrithēsan kai eipan autō· Ho patēr hēmōn Abraam estin. legei autois ho Iēsous· Ei tekna tou Abraam este, ta erga tou Abraam epoieite·

paragraphs.text: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I heard from God: this did not Abraham.
paragraphs.original: νῦν δὲ ζητεῖτέ με ἀποκτεῖναι, ἄνθρωπον ὃς τὴν ἀλήθειαν ὑμῖν λελάληκα ἣν ἤκουσα παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ· τοῦτο Ἀβραὰμ οὐκ ἐποίησεν.
paragraphs.translit: nyn de zēteite me apokteinai, anthrōpon hos tēn alētheian hymin lelalēka hēn ēkousa para tou theou· touto Abraam ouk epoiēsen.

paragraphs.text: Ye do the works of your father. They said unto him, We were not born of fornication; we have one Father, [even] God.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε τὰ ἔργα τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν. εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Ἡμεῖς ἐκ πορνείας οὐ γεγεννήμεθα· ἕνα πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν θεόν.
paragraphs.translit: hymeis poieite ta erga tou patros hymōn. eipan autō· Hēmeis ek porneias ou gegennēmetha· hena patera echomen ton theon.

paragraphs.text: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I came forth and am come from God; for neither have I come of myself, but he sent me.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ ὁ θεὸς πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἦν ἠγαπᾶτε ἂν ἐμέ, ἐγὼ γὰρ ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἥκω· οὐδὲ γὰρ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ ἐλήλυθα, ἀλλʼ ἐκεῖνός με ἀπέστειλεν.
paragraphs.translit: eipen autois ho Iēsous· Ei ho theos patēr hymōn ēn ēgapate an eme, egō gar ek tou theou exēlthon kai hēkō· oude gar apʼ emautou elēlytha, allʼ ekeinos me apesteilen.

paragraphs.text: Why do ye not understand my speech? [Even] because ye cannot hear my word.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τί τὴν λαλιὰν τὴν ἐμὴν οὐ γινώσκετε; ὅτι οὐ δύνασθε ἀκούειν τὸν λόγον τὸν ἐμόν.
paragraphs.translit: dia ti tēn lalian tēn emēn ou ginōskete; hoti ou dynasthe akouein ton logon ton emon.

paragraphs.text: Ye are of [your] father the devil, and the lusts of your father it is your will to do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and standeth not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father thereof.
paragraphs.original: ὑμεῖς ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ διαβόλου ἐστὲ καὶ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν θέλετε ποιεῖν. ἐκεῖνος ἀνθρωποκτόνος ἦν ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς, καὶ ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ οὐκ ἔστηκεν, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν αὐτῷ. ὅταν λαλῇ τὸ ψεῦδος, ἐκ τῶν ἰδίων λαλεῖ, ὅτι ψεύστης ἐστὶν καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hymeis ek tou patros tou diabolou este kai tas epithymias tou patros hymōn thelete poiein. ekeinos anthrōpoktonos ēn apʼ archēs, kai en tē alētheia ouk estēken, hoti ouk estin alētheia en autō. hotan lalē to pseudos, ek tōn idiōn lalei, hoti pseustēs estin kai ho patēr autou.

paragraphs.text: But because I say the truth, ye believe me not.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ δὲ ὅτι τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι.
paragraphs.translit: egō de hoti tēn alētheian legō, ou pisteuete moi.

paragraphs.text: Which of you convicteth me of sin? If I say truth, why do ye not believe me?
paragraphs.original: τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐλέγχει με περὶ ἁμαρτίας; εἰ ἀλήθειαν λέγω, διὰ τί ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετέ μοι;
paragraphs.translit: tis ex hymōn elenchei me peri hamartias; ei alētheian legō, dia ti hymeis ou pisteuete moi;

paragraphs.text: He that is of God heareth the words of God: for this cause ye hear [them] not, because ye are not of God.
paragraphs.original: ὁ ὢν ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ θεοῦ ἀκούει· διὰ τοῦτο ὑμεῖς οὐκ ἀκούετε ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἐστέ.
paragraphs.translit: ho ōn ek tou theou ta rhēmata tou theou akouei· dia touto hymeis ouk akouete hoti ek tou theou ouk este.

paragraphs.text: The Jews answered and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a demon?
paragraphs.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ· Οὐ καλῶς λέγομεν ἡμεῖς ὅτι Σαμαρίτης εἶ σὺ καὶ δαιμόνιον ἔχεις;
paragraphs.translit: Apekrithēsan hoi Ioudaioi kai eipan autō· Ou kalōs legomen hēmeis hoti Samaritēs ei sy kai daimonion echeis;

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered, I have not a demon; but I honor my Father, and ye dishonor me.
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἐγὼ δαιμόνιον οὐκ ἔχω, ἀλλὰ τιμῶ τὸν πατέρα μου, καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀτιμάζετέ με.
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē Iēsous· Egō daimonion ouk echō, alla timō ton patera mou, kai hymeis atimazete me.

paragraphs.text: But I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
paragraphs.original: ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ ζητῶ τὴν δόξαν μου· ἔστιν ὁ ζητῶν καὶ κρίνων.
paragraphs.translit: egō de ou zētō tēn doxan mou· estin ho zētōn kai krinōn.

paragraphs.text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my word, he shall never see death.
paragraphs.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐάν τις τὸν ἐμὸν λόγον τηρήσῃ, θάνατον οὐ μὴ θεωρήσῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
paragraphs.translit: amēn amēn legō hymin, ean tis ton emon logon tērēsē, thanaton ou mē theōrēsē eis ton aiōna.

paragraphs.text: The Jews said unto him, Now we know that thou hast a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my word, he shall never taste of death.
paragraphs.original: εἶπον αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι· Νῦν ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι δαιμόνιον ἔχεις. Ἀβραὰμ ἀπέθανεν καὶ οἱ προφῆται, καὶ σὺ λέγεις· Ἐάν τις τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσῃ, οὐ μὴ γεύσηται θανάτου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα·
paragraphs.translit: eipon autō hoi Ioudaioi· Nyn egnōkamen hoti daimonion echeis. Abraam apethanen kai hoi prophētai, kai sy legeis· Ean tis ton logon mou tērēsē, ou mē geusētai thanatou eis ton aiōna·

paragraphs.text: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, who died? and the prophets died: whom makest thou thyself?
paragraphs.original: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ, ὅστις ἀπέθανεν; καὶ οἱ προφῆται ἀπέθανον· τίνα σεαυτὸν ποιεῖς;
paragraphs.translit: mē sy meizōn ei tou patros hēmōn Abraam, hostis apethanen; kai hoi prophētai apethanon· tina seauton poieis;

paragraphs.text: Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing: it is my Father that glorifieth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God;
paragraphs.original: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς· Ἐὰν ἐγὼ δοξάσω ἐμαυτόν, ἡ δόξα μου οὐδέν ἐστιν· ἔστιν ὁ πατήρ μου ὁ δοξάζων με, ὃν ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι θεὸς ἡμῶν ἐστιν,
paragraphs.translit: apekrithē Iēsous· Ean egō doxasō emauton, hē doxa mou ouden estin· estin ho patēr mou ho doxazōn me, hon hymeis legete hoti theos hēmōn estin,

paragraphs.text: and ye have not known him: but I know him; and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be like unto you, a liar: but I know him, and keep his word.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὐκ ἐγνώκατε αὐτόν, ἐγὼ δὲ οἶδα αὐτόν· κἂν εἴπω ὅτι οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν, ἔσομαι ὅμοιος ὑμῖν ψεύστης· ἀλλὰ οἶδα αὐτὸν καὶ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ τηρῶ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ouk egnōkate auton, egō de oida auton· kan eipō hoti ouk oida auton, esomai homoios hymin pseustēs· alla oida auton kai ton logon autou tērō.

paragraphs.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day; and he saw it, and was glad.
paragraphs.original: Ἀβραὰμ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ἠγαλλιάσατο ἵνα ἴδῃ τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἐμήν, καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἐχάρη.
paragraphs.translit: Abraam ho patēr hymōn ēgalliasato hina idē tēn hēmeran tēn emēn, kai eiden kai echarē.

paragraphs.text: The Jews therefore said unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
paragraphs.original: εἶπον οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πρὸς αὐτόν· Πεντήκοντα ἔτη οὔπω ἔχεις καὶ Ἀβραὰμ ἑώρακας;
paragraphs.translit: eipon oun hoi Ioudaioi pros auton· Pentēkonta etē oupō echeis kai Abraam heōrakas;

paragraphs.text: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was born, I am.
paragraphs.original: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς· Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, πρὶν Ἀβραὰμ γενέσθαι ἐγὼ εἰμί.
paragraphs.translit: eipen autois Iēsous· Amēn amēn legō hymin, prin Abraam genesthai egō eimi.

paragraphs.text: They took up stones therefore to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple.
paragraphs.original: ἦραν οὖν λίθους ἵνα βάλωσιν ἐπʼ αὐτόν· Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἐκρύβη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ēran oun lithous hina balōsin epʼ auton· Iēsous de ekrybē kai exēlthen ek tou hierou.
